code_hints: If final_url matches ^https://www.moncler.com/(en-[a-z]{2})/?$, programmatically navigate to https://www.moncler.com/$1/men/outerwear before PLP scraping.
After initial navigation, attempt cookie consent: click any of [#onetrust-accept-btn-handler, button#onetrust-accept-btn-handler, button[aria-label*="Accept all cookies" i]] if present.
Wait for at least one PLP tile using selector a[href*="/en-jp/"][href*="/products/"] before extracting.
If no PLP tiles after wait, try header nav fallback: click a[href*="/men" i] then a[href*="/outerwear" i] with small delays, then re-wait for tiles.
Support 'Load more' pagination by clicking button[aria-label*="Load more" i] or button[data-testid*="load-more" i] until absent or disabled. Scroll into view before clicking to trigger lazy loading.
On PDP, prefer price from [data-testid*="Price" i]; if missing, read meta[itemprop="price"].
rationale: The scraper landed on the locale homepage (/en-jp) which contains no product tiles. We switch the entry to a stable category PLP (/en-jp/men/outerwear), add cookie-consent handling, and wait explicitly for product links. Flexible selectors target Moncler’s products/ PDP path pattern and common price/title attributes. URL rules normalize accidental homepage hits to a PLP, constrain crawling to commerce paths, and block known non-commerce/brand domains.
